regions.merged_text: I shall remember you all in my High-Mass tomorrow. Please have them all as much as conveinent - have them all - supply my want of appreciation and gratitude to God for the uncountable mercies and graces we have received these 48 years - graces and mercies that have, not only surrounded us but in which, without our half realizing it, we are continually immersed in God' merciful graces / like the air that permiates us. Glory be to God! How little is it possible for poor mortals that we are, to appreciate as we ought, or to be properly grateful to God and our benefactors this side of Heaven! But after all that is what we became candidates for - candidates for the Kingdom of Heaven - when we were baptized; and every time we receive the Holy Sacraments of Mother Church we take another step forward, virtually pleading with our angels for another white bean at every step. How wonderful and how legion are our privileged opportunités ! Glory be to God a billion.
